adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` copies legacy `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` lines into the new `embeddable_hosts.host` column via raw SQL `INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`, so values like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` are persisted verbatim. The model normalization that strips protocol/path is in `EmbeddableHost`'s `before_validation`, but it is bypassed by the migration. Later allow-checks use `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` which parses the URL and queries `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, e.g. `discourse.org`, which will not match a stored `http://discourse.org` row. This can break previously-allowed hosts after upgrade, while Fabricate-based specs (which create records through the model and thus normalize) would not catch it.
